retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait of two musicians interacting with instruments against a stark white background, featuring a distinct header with script and thin sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: musicians with guitars on white background
high-key studio portrait with header text

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast studio photograph of two male musicians in profile, facing each other while playing guitars. The composition is anchored by a stark white negative space and a structured typographic header at the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between dark clothing and bright white background
Horizontal typographic header balancing vertical subjects
Diagonal lines created by guitar necks and arms
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no visible floor line
Subjects in profile or three-quarter view
Header text contained within the top 15% of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects positioned on the left and right thirds, scaled to fill the lower 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection of the two guitars in the center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the script text at the top, down the subjects' faces, following the guitar necks to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space surrounding the subjects, providing a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Ochre/Tan (guitar bodies and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with desaturated, dark-valued subjects for maximum silhouette effect.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of elegant copperplate-style script and geometric thin sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: High slant, fluid connections, varying stroke weight
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand in script should be ornate and central
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, flowing script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule lines separating text tiers

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, slanted script aesthetic
Provides the geometric, thin sans-serif contrast

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of two men in 1970s attire (denim and button-downs) playing acoustic and electric guitars, facing each other and smiling, against a seamless white background. Leave the top 20% of the image as empty white space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-tier typographic header in the top white space. The top line should be an elegant black script font. The second line should be a thin, wide-tracked sans-serif in a dark brick red, separated by a thin horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Are there two distinct font styles in the header?
Is the tracking on the sans-serif text wide?
Do the subjects appear to be interacting/playing music?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the frame edges
Verify the white background is consistent and without gradients
Check that the script font is legible despite its flourishes
Confirm the subjects' poses feel candid and joyful
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + high-key white + [Script Name] + [Sans-Serif Subtitle] + 70s styling
